messages.subject: CFA model warning:  lavaan WARNING: the optimizer warns that a solution has NOT been found!
parts:
I have a data set with 218 cases.  I am trying to fit the following CFA model:

myModel<-'ei=~EI1+EI2+EI3
si=~si1+si2
id=~id1+id2
is=~is1+is2
ol=~ol1+ol2+ol3+ol4
os=~os1+os2+os3
ei~~si
ei~~id
ei~~is
ei~~ol
ei~~os
si~~id
si~~is
si~~ol
si~~os
id~~is
id~~ol
id~~os
is~~ol
is~~os
ol~~os
ei~~ei
si~~si
id~~id
is~~is
ol~~ol
os~~os'

I use the following command:
res<-cfa(model=myModel,data=dat1,estimator="ML")

I then get the warning:
Warning message:
In lav_model_estimate(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavpartable = lavpartable,  :
  lavaan WARNING: the optimizer warns that a solution has NOT been found!

The "show" method gives the following:
> show(res)
lavaan 0.6-5 did NOT end normally after 4562 iterations

messages.subject: Re: CFA model warning:  lavaan WARNING: the optimizer warns that a solution has NOT been found!
parts:
I then get the warning:
Warning message:
In lav_model_estimate(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavpartable = lavpartable,  :
  lavaan WARNING: the optimizer warns that a solution has NOT been found!

You have defined a few constructs with only 2 indicators.  Unless they are substantially correlated with other factors, it might be necessary to also fix the second loading to 1 for identification (the first loading is already fixed by cfa() by default).
